title: DeepSeek’s biggest story of the day
summary: DeepSeek’s biggest story of the day was the official public-beta launch of DeepSeek-V4-Flash API , with DeepSeek stating that its upgraded agent capabilities now surpass V4-Pro-Preview and that the API now supports the Responses API format and is “fully adapted for Codex” ( @deepseek_ai ). In a follow-up, DeepSeek clarified that the improvement applies only to the Flash API , while V4-Pro API/App/Web remain unchanged for now; V4-Pro official is still pending ( @deepseek_ai ).
